sloka: पाने प्रसक्तो भवतु स्त्रीष्वक्षेषु च नित्यशः ।काम्क्रोधाभिभूतस्तु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४१॥
transliteration: pāne prasakto bhavatu strīṣvakṣeṣu ca nityaśaḥ ।kāmkrodhābhibhūtastu yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-41॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be always addicted to wine, women and gambling and be swayed by desire and anger
